This layer represents the scientific watershed and sub-watershed boundaries within the Conservation Halton jurisdiction. In some areas, the extents of this layer may not align precisely with Conservation Halton’s administrative boundary.

The watersheds were delineated using a digital elevation model (DEM) with a 2.5 m cell size, derived from a LiDAR survey conducted in April 2018.

Please note that this dataset reflects a snapshot in time and may not capture changes that have occurred in the watershed since the LiDAR survey.
